title: pyrus amygdaliformis var. eriopleura
intro: Pyrus amygdaliformis var. eriopleura, commonly known as Eriobotrya, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. Eriobotrya is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Eriobotrya include its use as an anti-diabetic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent. The bioactive constituents of Eriobotrya include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
